caption: The drawing depicts a young girl with short yellow hair, dressed in a blue top with puffed sleeves, a light gray knee-length skirt, blue socks, and black shoes, standing on a gray rectangular surface. In front of her is a green and red object resembling an old-fashioned stove with a circular red bowl placed on top. Attached to the stove is a tall green post with red pipe-like tubing extending upwards and looping, ending in a downward curve. The girl is holding the end of the red tubing with both hands. The background of the image is plain and uncolored, and the artist's name "Chas. F. Moss" along with the year "'98" is written in red in the bottom left corner of the image.
title: Toy Bank: Dutch Girl at Well
